facts.fact: Decree no. 2022-1944 of 30 December 2022 approved the statutes of Congo's national information systems security agency (ANSSI), created by law no. 30-2019 of 10 October 2019, a public body under the Presidency tasked with protecting national cyberspace, managing security incidents and issuing alerts, with a CERT within its operations directorate.
